\[
I^{t+1} = I^{t} + \lambda \sum_{n \in \{N,S,E,W\}} g\bigl(|\nabla_n I^{t}|\bigr)\, \nabla_n I^{t},
\qquad
g(d) = e^{-(d/K)^2} \;\text{ or }\; \frac{1}{1 + (d/K)^2}
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(\nabla_n I\): The difference to the neighbor in direction n
- \(g\): The conduction function
- \(K\): The edge threshold
- \(\lambda\): The step size
- \(t\): The step number

nabla_N I is the difference to the north neighbor, I(x, y - 1) - I(x, y), and the same for south, east and west. Each step moves a value toward its neighbors by lambda times the differences, weighted by the conduction g. Small differences have g near 1 and are smoothed. Large differences, edges, have g near 0 and are kept.
